remedies.name: Green kiwifruit
remedies.summary: Fresh green kiwifruit was one of the three foods or supplements in the four-week constipation study.

remedies.name: Prunes
remedies.summary: Prunes are dried plums. The same four-week constipation study included a prune group.

remedies.name: Psyllium husk
remedies.summary: Psyllium was the fiber supplement compared with kiwifruit and prunes in the same study.

studies.title: Exploratory Comparative Effectiveness Trial of Green Kiwifruit, Psyllium, or Prunes in US Patients With Chronic Constipation
studies.summary: The four-week US study compared three groups. The participant count is for the full study across all groups.

origins.summary: Kew lists the plant as native to central and southern China.
A clinical paper documents traditional use of dried plums for constipation without naming a single originating community.
Kew records native populations of Plantago ovata in parts of all four continents.
